title: AAGL Bundle Schema — arch_floorplan_v0.1
description:
Complete self-contained validator for profile arch_floorplan_v0.1. Bundles THREE layers into one file:
 (A) AAGL CONTAINER LAYER — structural invariants for chunks/nodes/relations (normative per AAGL Spec § 5.3, § 5.4, § 5.5). These constraints are type-blind and profile-agnostic; they are what the Rust core engine enforces.
 (B) AAGL THEME MECHANISM LAYER — structural invariants for views/*.json (normative per AAGL Spec § 8.1). Again profile-agnostic.
 (C) PROFILE arch_floorplan_v0.1 — semantic metadata contracts (what fields go in metadata for each node type) and coords layout registry hints.
 When validating a chunk file, use $defs/chunk (oneOf picks correct metadata branch via profile_type). When validating a theme file, use $defs/theme.

target_chunk.description: chunk_id hosting the destination — cross-chunk routing via manifest.spatial_index (§ 5.4)

rel_type.description: Allowed codes (§ 5.4). A profile MAY override this list via manifest.profile.core_hints.relation_codes; when so, edit this enum.

node_metadata_arch.description: Semantic contract for metadata per node type (Profile arch_floorplan_v0.1 layer C). Which branch applies is chosen by node.metadata.profile_type.

finish_code.description: Optional finish/layer on top of material.

sill_height_mm.description: Distance from finished floor to bottom of window glass.

node.description: AAGL Container Layer § 5.3 — every node exposes exactly four required structural keys. Any other top-level keys are profile-defined extensions and ignored by Rust core.

parent_id.description: § 5.3: Hierarchical ownership pointer. Root nodes MUST use literal string "genesis" (never null). Core walks this tree for cascade-delete.

coords.description: § 4: Flat list of 64-bit signed integers. Layout/meaning (AABB, quad 4-pt, packed vertices) is Profile-defined — see manifest.profile.core_hints.coords_layout_registry in manifest.json for per-type layouts of this profile.

relations.description: § 5.3: Non-hierarchical cross-node pointers with 3-field structural contract (§ 5.4). Semantics of rel_type are Profile-defined.

metadata.description: For THIS profile arch_floorplan_v0.1: one of the six metadata_arch branches above, selected by metadata.profile_type. § 5.3 Container layer requires zero keys here; all shape rules come from the profile contract embedded in this schema.

chunk.description: AAGL Container Layer § 5 — sharded sub-graph file. § 5.1: three required top-level keys. § 5.2: bounds REQUIRED for chunk_genesis (6-element i64 AABB).

chunk_id.description: Unique id, matches manifest routing key (§ 5.1).

version.description: Monotonic chunk-level version counter for OCC (§ 5.1, § 6).

bounds.description: § 5.1 / § 5.2: Optional AABB [x_min,y_min,z_min, x_max,y_max,z_max]. REQUIRED for chunk_genesis.

theme_style_rule.description: Profile arch_floorplan_v0.1 style-rule contract. Keys are: stroke_color_hex, line_weight_mm, line_dash_code, fill_color_hex, hatch_ordinal, hatch_scale, label_text_template, label_font_size_mm, label_anchor_ordinal. Mirror of manifest.profile.view_style_schema in manifest.json.

theme.description: AAGL Container Layer § 8.1 — three-tier view theme mechanism (profile-agnostic structural shape, plus profile-owned style rule keys above).

spec_version.description: § 8.1: AAGL container spec version this theme structure conforms to.

fallback.description: § 8.1 — Lowest-priority tier. Whole-theme defaults. Applied per-field shallow merge: keys not present in by_type/by_id fall through to here.

by_type.description: § 8.1 — Middle-priority tier. Keys are discriminator values resolved via manifest.profile.view_type_key (this profile uses metadata.profile_type). Applied per-field: missing keys fall through to fallback.

by_id.description: § 8.1 — Highest-priority tier. Keys are exact node_id strings. Applied per-field: missing keys fall through to by_type, then fallback.
